PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior pastry chef with nine years of experience running high-volume dessert
sections in premium hotels and patisseries. Known for laminated doughs,
plated desserts, and training junior chefs to consistent five-star standards.
Seeking a leadership kitchen role with creative ownership of the menu.

SKILLS
- Patisserie: viennoiserie, entremets, sugar work, chocolate tempering
- Baking science: lamination, fermentation control, hydration ratios
- Kitchen operations: HACCP hygiene audits, stock rotation, vendor selection
- Menu design: seasonal dessert menus, costing, allergen mapping
- Team: training rosters, station scheduling, service coordination

EXPERIENCE

Head Pastry Chef — Saffron Leaf Grand Hotel, Nashik

- Redesigned the dessert menu quarterly; dessert revenue grew 28% in two years.

- Passed every municipal hygiene inspection with zero criticals for six years.
